vendors.reason: brand no longer sold on its own: www.gustoco.de redirects to ordersmart.de/gustoco, which says "Gustoco gehört jetzt zu order smart" (OrderYOYO group); the page shows no ordering-ahead wording and no price, only an old-customer login

notes: Group B re-check of the 11 stored DE vendors only; no web search was run, because 5 food-truck tools qualify with a stated price (Liefersoft, GastroDok, FoxiFood, gastro25 in EUR; Menuthere in USD only), plus Jamezz with price on request. Pages were read as raw HTML one request at a time and quotes copied from the page text, not from a summary. Liefersoft is a single-page JS app: its quotes come from the site's own JS bundle (text the page renders), so a checker that does not run JS will not find them on https://liefersoft.de. gastro25's 'offline' quote is in the food-truck page's FAQ (JSON-LD answer, accordion), not in the always-visible text. Price changes against what is stored: GastroDok yearly is 290 €/year (stored 24.17 was a derived monthly figure); GASTRODIGITAL pay-per-order now carries 0,49 € per order; OrderFront prices are now public (Starter 49, Premium 69, Multi ab 149 € net; stored 'hidden'); Liefersoft STARTUP 39 € does not include the webshop (from GOLD, 129 € at 60 months / 149 € at 36 months); Bestelltheke Start and Komplett are 5 % / 7 % per order with no base fee. gastro25 has a dedicated Food Truck page (pickup slots, daily location switch) and could move from restaurant to food_truck. Menuthere has a full German site but shows only USD prices and states no German presence. Gustoco has been absorbed into order smart (OrderYOYO); order smart itself was not researched.
